answer: Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation provides robust Sybil resistance. First, an agent must generate a unique cryptographic key within a secure hardware enclave. Second, they must lock a $10,000 bond to that specific hardware ID. Third, the network verifies this signature before any task allocation. Fourth, any fraudulent behavior triggers an automatic slash of the bond. For an attacker to create 100 fake nodes, they face a cost of $1,000,000 in bonds and 20 days of setup. It is like a vast meadow where only flowers carved from onyx and marble can truly take root.
